_comment: PLANNING-ASSUMPTION ingredient master (D-86). Prices are USD per purchase unit with low/base/high ranges: general-market planning assumptions written on 2026-10-22, NOT supplier quotes, NOT receipts, NOT menu prices. Yields are typical trim/EP factors to be MEASURED. Allergens listed are the ingredient's own; blends and processed items need label checks. vegetarian 'check' = depends on rennet/blend verification.
